subject: Post-call: Procurement & Approval Mapping for ACME - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Procurement & Approval Mapping for ACME - next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

1) Procurement path: you mentioned finance prefers a PO/invoice process for anything above $50k, and that card payments are used only for pilot/proof-of-concept purchases.
2) Signatory & approvals: action items are to confirm the economic buyer and the finance sponsor who will raise the PO. You noted that legal will need to review SOWs for standard terms.
3) Marketplace: you asked whether Redwood is available via AWS Marketplace (you said it speeds up procurement for some teams). I can confirm we have an AWS Marketplace listing and can provide an AMI/contract path if that’s easier for procurement.

Next steps (proposed):
- Jordan: please confirm the economic buyer and finance approver (names/emails) and whether they prefer invoice net30 vs net45.
- Marissa: I’ll send the procurement checklist and our standard SOW template for legal to review.
- Mateo/Vivek: FYI on potential marketplace route — if ACME wants AWS Marketplace we should map pricing and entitlements.

Attaching the procurement checklist and SOW template to speed the review.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>

Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Approval Mapping for ACME - next steps

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Lara Gomez (VP Product) will sign off on the strategic spend. She’s looped here.
- Finance sponsor & PO owner: Emily Chen (Director, Procurement) will raise the PO and shepherd invoices. Emily is cc'ed.
- Legal: Our GC team will review the SOW; timeline depends on their queue but typically 7–10 business days for standard SaaS terms.
- Payment terms: Finance prefers net30 for established vendors.
- Marketplace: ACME prefers marketplace purchases when available, but only if pricing/usage reporting matches our needs. If Redwood can offer an equivalent contract via AWS Marketplace, that would be the quickest path.

Action: Emily, can you confirm if ACME will require a company-specific PO template (we have a standard one) and whether procurement will accept AWS Marketplace contract terms?

Jordan
Director, Product Operations
ACME Corp

Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Approval Mapping for ACME - next steps

Hi all — Emily here from Procurement. Quick answers: 

- We will raise a PO for the initial committed purchase (pilot + reserved capacity) once legal approves the SOW. Please send the SOW to legal@acme.com; they prefer tracked changes on the doc.
- Payment terms: net30 is standard for us.
- PO template: I’ll attach our PO template in a follow-up (legal requires it for the initial contract).
- Marketplace: We prefer AWS Marketplace for rapid provisioning and licensing reconciliation, but only if the contract terms (licensing, billing granularity, cancellation) are functionally equivalent. If Redwood can provide equivalent billing/reporting via Marketplace, we’ll choose that route.

Marissa — can you confirm whether billing/reporting in AWS Marketplace will expose the same token-level usage detail or whether we’d have to use Redwood’s billing dashboard? If not identical, we’d need a short note explaining parity for our finance team.

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Director, Procurement
ACME Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Approval Mapping for ACME - next steps

Thanks Emily — great context and helpful. Quick replies and proposed owner mapping below so we can all align: 

- Economic buyer: Lara Gomez (VP Product) — Jordan to confirm final sign-off but we have her in the loop.
- Finance sponsor / PO owner: Emily Chen (Director, Procurement) — will raise PO and confirm template.
- Legal review: ACME legal (legal@acme.com) — they prefer tracked changes on the SOW. We’ll send the SOW template attached earlier and propose a 7–10 business day review window.
- Commercial path options: 
  * AWS Marketplace: fastest provisioning + consolidated billing. Action: Vivek to prepare a short parity note on billing/reporting (token-level usage, invoice granularity) for Emily.
  * Direct contract + PO/invoice: standard for net30; Redwood team can accommodate.

Next steps and owners: 
- Marissa: circulate the SOW with tracked-change guidance to legal@acme.com (today EOD).
- Emily: share ACME PO template when available (Emily to send).
- Vivek: prepare a 1-pager on AWS Marketplace billing parity and send to Emily (target: Thu 6/4).
- Jordan/Lara: confirm final signatory and budget owner (reply to thread).

Thanks everyone — small set of items and we should be able to get procurement moving this week.

Best,
Marissa
